machineDrafts.name: Halvik EP 80-200 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump
machineDrafts.description:
End-suction, single stage, back pull-out centrifugal pump set with an 18.5 kW motor, designed for continuous operation pumping clean or slightly contaminated process cooling water in industrial systems.

Main components include cast iron volute casing and casing cover, stainless steel shaft, closed cast iron impeller, bronze wear rings, single mechanical seal, grease-lubricated deep groove ball bearings (6309-C3 DE, 6308-C3 NDE), flexible spacer coupling, base plate, and an electric motor.

Operating limits include liquid temperature 5 to 60 °C, allowed flow range 35 to 140 m³/h, maximum casing pressure 16 bar at 20 °C, and a maximum of 6 starts per hour.

machineDrafts.name: MTC-420
machineDrafts.description:
The MTC-420 is a two-axis CNC turning center with a 45-degree slant bed of cast iron, intended for the turning, drilling, and threading of metal workpieces in industrial use.

Main components include an EN-GJL-300 cast iron bed with roller linear guides, an AC spindle motor with a 12-station servo turret (VDI 30), a hydraulic tailstock, a hydraulic unit, a central lubrication system, a coolant system with tank and immersion pump, a chip conveyor, and an electrical cabinet with an MC-8T control.

Operating limits include a spindle speed range of 30 to 4,500 rpm, maximum turning diameter of 420 mm, nominal hydraulic system pressure of 35 bar, and permitted ambient operating temperature between 10 and 35 °C.

machineDrafts.name: RSV-37 (variable speed drive)
machineDrafts.description:
Supplies compressed air at 7 bar to the production hall: pneumatic tools, actuators, and blow-off nozzles.

Main parts include a twin-screw air end with oil injection, 37 kW permanent magnet motor with frequency converter, oil separator vessel, air-cooled oil cooler and aftercooler, electronic condensate drain, and AirLogic 5 controller.

Main operating limits: maximum working pressure 8 bar, minimum working pressure 5.5 bar, motor speed range 1,000 to 3,600 rpm, ambient temperature range 0 to 46 °C.
